scripts.build:web: autoreconf -fi && emconfigure ./configure --enable-wasm && emmake make clean && emmake make regenerate-help-index && emmake make && emmake make check
scripts.test: npm run build:web && npm run test:built
scripts.test:built: npm run test:source && npm run test:browser:built
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:web && npm run test:browser:built
scripts.test:browser:smoke: node tests/acceptance/run-testcafe.js --test 'Logo starts and displays its welcome message'
scripts.test:runner:browser: node -e "const result = require('node:child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'tests/acceptance/runner.test.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: Object.assign({}, process.env, { RUNNER_BROWSER_TESTS: '1' }) }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1)"
scripts.test:settings: npm run build:web && npm run test:settings:built
scripts.test:settings:chrome: npm run build:web && node tests/acceptance/run-testcafe.js --browser chrome --fixture 'Settings persistence'
scripts.test:settings:firefox: npm run build:web && node tests/acceptance/run-testcafe.js --browser firefox --fixture 'Settings persistence'
scripts.test:autocomplete: npm run -s test:autocomplete:desktop && npm run -s test:autocomplete:phone
